copy.tagline: 搭建带侧栏和顶栏的KPI仪表盘页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成一个带图表的管理仪表盘前端页面
copy.tagline_en: Build a KPI dashboard with sidebar and top bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a management dashboard with charts

howto.what: 当用户要求生成管理后台或仪表板页面时,Claude 会输出一个标准单页布局:左侧固定导航、顶部栏、3-5 个 KPI 卡片、1-2 张图表,以及底部最近活动列表。
howto.when: 当用户提出要创建管理后台、仪表板或数据分析页面时触发;也可在要求带侧边栏与 KPI 卡片的界面时触发。

say.text: 给我生成一个管理后台首页,带侧边栏和顶栏
做一张数据分析看板,包含 KPI 卡片和两张图表
say.note: 按模板安排卡片与图表区域。

say.text: 建一个运营监控页面,底部加上最近活动列表
say.note: 活动列表会放在页面底部。

howto.what_en: When asked to create an admin dashboard or analytics page, Claude outputs a single-page layout with fixed left sidebar, top bar, 3-5 KPI cards, 1-2 charts, and a recent activity list at the bottom.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests an admin dashboard, analytics board, or a page with a sidebar and KPI cards.

say_en.text: Create an admin home page with a sidebar and top bar.
Make an analytics dashboard with KPI cards and two charts.
say_en.note: Arranges cards and chart areas per template.

say_en.text: Build an operations monitoring page with a recent activity list at the bottom.
say_en.note: Activity list appears at the page bottom.
